itemdesc-rotconcentrate: Cook six Rot in each of the four cooking-pot ingredient slots (24 total) to brew one concentrate. Sneak + right-click the top of a solid floor to place a pile. Attracts zombies within 32 blocks; they eat one concentrate from the pile every two seconds until it is empty.
itemdesc-mycobiotic: Rot concentrate brewed with a poisonous mushroom.
itemdesc-mycobioticcure: Craft from Mycobiotic plus a clean bandage or a horsetail poultice. Take the first dose within two in-game days of infection, then one dose at least one in-game day apart until six doses cure the infection.
itemdesc-clothes-face-alphafuneralmask: 500 durability. While worn and crouching, zombies ignore you and follow your lead. Costs 1 durability every 5 real seconds of crouching.
itemdesc-rotcoveredtunic: Grass clothing saturated with Rot Concentrate. Zombies ignore you immediately while the tunic is worn and has durability. Consumes 1 durability each second it is equipped (20 total). Slows walking speed by 30% while worn; taking it off restores normal speed. Causes 3 HP of sickness on first wear of each tunic.
blockdesc-pitbonfire: Place over connected FULL 32-firewood ground piles. Right-click with four firewood, then ignite with a torch or firestarter. An uncovered lure for the undead.
blockdesc-pitbonfireloaded: Loaded with four firewood. Ignite with a torch or firestarter to burn the connected full firewood stacks below.
blockdesc-strongholdwood: Reinforces newly placed eligible blocks in this zone to strength 5. Stronger strongholds take priority. Attracts migrating zombies.
traitdesc-infected-untreated: untreated; start the Mycobiotic Cure within {0}.
traitdesc-infected-toolate: untreated; too late for the Mycobiotic Cure.
infected-acquired: You have acquired the trait: Zombie infection. See Character > Traits.
